summary: 1. Key operational findings The Oct 19 production day posted 19,065 BCM against a 24,072.2 BCM target (-20.80%), the cycle's second-largest daily miss, and MTD widened sharply to 511,376 BCM against 553,661.0 BCM (-7.64%), reversing four straight days of narrowing (Oct 16 -6.69%, Oct 17 -7.06%, Oct 18 -7.04%, Oct 19 -7.64%). 2. Three things stand out: 1. 3. Gross fleet lost volume across the excavator and dump-truck faults came to 28,412.8 BCM, 1.49 times today's own output -- the first day this cycle lost volume has clearly exceeded production rather than nearly matching it, with EX-247, EX-253 and EX-340 alone accounting for 20,280 BCM of the excavator shortfall. 2. 4. EX-340's hydraulic-leakage breakdown cleared at 5:30 PM after two full days down, but EX-247 reappeared in the Daily Availability Final Report's by-exception fault table at 0.00% avail after being read as suspended for two straight reports (Oct 17, Oct 18) -- reversing a pattern this KB had treated as resolved. 3. 5. An LV-93 rollover at about 00:30 on Oct 20, just after this report's cutoff, sent one person to a clinic for a suspected head injury (the other two examined and cleared) with vehicle damage to the antenna, glass, mirror, snorkel and differential hub, classified high potential and major production loss. 6. Confirm with maintenance whether EX-247's return to the active fault table is permanent or a one-day reporting artifact -- the unit has swung between "suspended" and "active 24h down" twice this cycle already. 7. Confirm LV-93's return-to-service date and whether its downtime shows against the light-vehicle fleet from the Oct 20 report onward; the Oct 19 report predates the incident. 8. Yesterday's blast (Oct 18, blast no. 17, 850-501 PS, 300 kg explosives) logs 0 BCM blasted volume -- confirm whether the survey measurement is pending or this is a data gap. 9. The Q4 Recovery Plan deck family split into two parallel version tracks today (v9_FINAL and a separately-edited "_v4_FINAL_Muneeb" variant) -- worth a dedicated read to confirm both track the same plan before the next full compile pass. The Grade Control Sheet, the Recovery Plan/DT-Requirement version bumps, the new Cost Management rental-cost-per-BCM files, the Revenue Budget re-save, the August forecast re-save, the PTO safety berm, the Dispatch reconciliation workbook, and the HR CV thread were registered by name only, not opened. No new standalone survey file (261020-INX-SUM) has landed, so [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] was not updated this pass. `publish_insights.py` was deliberately not run this pass -- the `wiki-insights-sync` task publishes separately at 11:00/17:00. Source: KNOWLEDGE/mining_operations_kb/RAW via the librarian compile protocol.
